# Explore our Museum

Our maritime heritage lives on the water with our living fleet, and in the gallery and boatshops. The new Wagner Education Center gives the collection more display space and room for our growing community. [Read about the history](https://www.cwb.org/history) of The Center for Wooden Boats.

## Current Exhibits

On view in the Wagner Education Center.

### PRIMA's Jubilee Art Exhibition: A Nautical Celebration

The Pacific Rim Institute of Marine Artists (PRIMA) was founded in 2016 by Austin Dwyer and Bob Bryant to build a community of maritime artists living on or near the Pacific Rim.

[**Learn more →**](https://www.cwb.org/prima-jubilee)

![PRIMA Jubilee Art Poster](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/8869d56a-1cd6-4682-9a92-964c19307dcd/PRIMA+Jubilee+Art+Poster+Crop.png)

### Historic Small Craft of the Pacific Northwest

Opened at the Wagner Education Center's Grand Opening on March 23, 2019, this exhibit features nine small craft, mostly from King County, many of which came from the active fleet.

[**Learn More →**](https://www.cwb.org/exhibit/historic-small-craft-of-the-pacific-nw)

![Center for Wooden Boats hanging boat exhibit](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/1571096840199-ELT5Y4EHAX3XHT523ZN4/HangingBoatExhibit-InstallationPhoto.jpg)
